ログ収集とは、各機器の記録を調査用の場所に集めることです。今回はその集約先にある: Log collection gathers records from devices into an investigation system. Here, only the collected records are available.
host=collector-01 は収集装置の名前です。event=colle: host=collector-01 names the collector. collection_stopped means collection stopped; collection_started means it resumed.
この設問では、収集停止中の認証ログは集約先へ届いておらず、後から回収できたかも未: Authentication logs during the outage did not reach the collector. Whether they were recovered later is unknown. Times are UTC.
欠けた時間帯の出来事を、記録がないことだけで否定できません。元の機器に残るログや: Missing records alone cannot rule out events during the gap. Check logs on the original device or another source.
手元の資料が 08:00 から 08:30 までしかないとき、09:00 の操作: Records covering 08:00–08:30 cannot establish whether an operation occurred at 09:00. Check your search scope before reporting that nothing was found.
集約先では 10:05 から 10:15 のログイン記録が見つかりませんでした。: No login records were found at the collector from 10:05 to 10:15. Which explanation fits the collector's status records?
収集装置の状態ログ・2 行。停止中の認証ログは未回収: Collector status logs: 2 lines; authentication logs during the outage have not been recovered
10:05〜10:15 はログインも停止していた。再開後に別の記録で利用状況を確: Logins also stopped from 10:05 to 10:15. Check other activity records after collection resumed.
止まったと記録されているのは収集装置です。利用者のログインも止まったとは確認でき: Only the collector is recorded as stopped. This does not establish that user logins stopped.
10:15 に収集が停止した。それ以前のログインの有無は、別の記録で確認する。: Collection stopped at 10:15. Check other records to establish whether logins occurred before then.
collection_stopped は10:05、collection_sta: collection_stopped is at 10:05 and collection_started is at 10:15. This answer reverses the times.
10:05〜10:15 は収集が停止していた。その間のログインの有無は、別の記録: Collection stopped from 10:05 to 10:15. Check other records to establish whether logins occurred during that period.
10:05 の収集停止から 10:15 の再開までは集約側の記録だけでは判断でき: The collector alone cannot establish activity between the stop at 10:05 and restart at 10:15. Check records on the original devices.
10:05 から 10:15 は収集が停止していました。集約先のログがないことは: Collection stopped from 10:05 to 10:15. Missing collector records do not establish that no logins occurred. Check the original authentication device and collection coverage.
ログインの記録だけでなく、収集装置の停止と再開の時刻を読みましょう。: Read when the collector stopped and restarted, as well as the available login records.
collection_stopped と collection_started: Distinguish collection_stopped from collection_started. Collector status and user login activity are separate facts.
収集停止は10:05、再開は10:15です。その間のログインの有無を、別の記録で: Collection stopped at 10:05 and resumed at 10:15. Choose the explanation that checks another source for logins during the gap.
「10:05〜10:15 は収集が停止していた。その間のログインの有無は、別の記: Choose the explanation stating that collection stopped from 10:05 to 10:15 and other records are needed to check login activity. Distinguish collection failure from user inactivity.
SOCroom の「対応記録」で、調査できた範囲・分からない点・次に確認すること: This prepares you to separate the investigated scope, unknowns, and next checks in SOCroom's response notes.
コンピューターの操作や状態を記録したもの。1 行ごとに時刻や操作の内容などが書か: A record of a computer's activity or state. Each line can contain a timestamp and action. It cannot establish information that was not recorded.
その記録が示す出来事の時間。資料の時刻の基準と、調べたい時間帯を確認して読みます: The time of the event described by a record. Check the time reference and the period under investigation.
日時の末尾の Z は UTC を表します。09:00 UTC は同じ日の 18:: Z at the end of a timestamp means UTC. 09:00 UTC is 18:00 Japan Standard Time on the same day.
この教材のログでは、記録に関係する端末やサーバーの名前を表す欄。アカウント名とは: In these logs, the field naming the relevant device or server. It is separate from the account name.
host=pc-demo → 端末名は pc-demo。: host=pc-demo → The device name is pc-demo.
その操作に記録されたアカウント名の欄。この名前があるだけでは、本人が操作した証明: The account recorded for an operation. Its presence does not prove the account owner performed the action.
user=haru → haru というアカウントの記録。: user=haru → A record using the haru account.
source の略。この教材の通信ログでは送信元、つまり通信の出発点を示します。: Short for source. In these network logs, it identifies where a connection begins.
src=192.0.2.10 → 送信元 IP アドレスは 192.0.2.10: src=192.0.2.10 → The source IP address is 192.0.2.10.
destination の略。この教材の通信ログでは送信先、つまり通信の行き先を: Short for destination. In these network logs, it identifies where a connection goes.
dst=203.0.113.70 → 送信先 IP アドレスは 203.0.11: dst=203.0.113.70 → The destination IP address is 203.0.113.70.
操作の結果を示す欄。この教材では success が成功、failed が失敗で: The operation's outcome. Here, success means success and failed means failure. Success does not necessarily establish safety.
一続きの接続や操作を区別する目印の ID。どの範囲をひと続きとするかは製品で異な: An ID distinguishing a sequence of connections or operations. Session scope varies by product; check the source system's specification in real investigations.
session=D10 の行どうしを同じセッションの記録として照合する。: Correlate lines with session=D10 as records from one session.
通信する機器や接続先を区別するためのアドレス。アドレスだけで操作者の身元や悪意は: An address identifying a network device or destination. An address alone does not establish identity or intent. All values here are illustrative.
192.0.2.10。IP アドレスの各数字を暗記する必要はありません。: 192.0.2.10. You do not need to memorize individual IP addresses.
アカウントなどを使って、利用者や機器を確かめる仕組み。ログイン時のパスワード確認: A mechanism for checking a user or device through an account or other information, such as a password check at login.
正しいパスワードを使ったログインが成功しても、本人が入力したかは別の確認事項です: Even a successful login with the correct password does not establish who entered it.
確認が必要な条件に当てはまったことを知らせる通知。攻撃の確定通知ではなく、調査の: A notification that a condition needs review. It starts an investigation; it does not establish an attack.
「短時間に認証失敗が増えた」というアラートを受け、関連ログと業務の予定を確認する: After an alert about increased authentication failures, review related logs and scheduled work.
末尾の Z は UTC という基準の時刻を使っている印です。初級・中級ではすべて: The final Z indicates UTC, a standard time reference. Beginner and intermediate exercises use UTC without time-zone conversion.
世界で共通に使う時刻の基準。日本標準時より 9 時間遅い基準です。初級・中級では: A shared global time reference, nine hours behind Japan Standard Time. Beginner and intermediate exercises use UTC without conversion; advanced exercises also practice converting time-zone offsets.
例えば host=pc-kai と入力します。pc-kai のように短い語でも、: For example, enter host=pc-kai. A shorter query such as pc-kai also works if it keeps the target visible and removes unrelated lines. Then click the target line to select it as your answer.
検索で行を絞り込み、pc-kai のログを選択してください。検索語の例は「hos: Narrow the logs with a search and select the log for pc-kai. One example query is host=pc-kai. Keep the target visible and hide at least one line.
端末名で検索し、pc-kai の記録を残しながら関係のない行を減らしましょう。: Search by host name to keep the pc-kai record while removing unrelated lines.
検索語の例は host=pc-kai です。pc-kai でも絞り込めます。前後: One example query is host=pc-kai. The shorter pc-kai also narrows the results. Do not include quotation marks.
例えば user=nao と検索すると、その文字を含むログが残ります。nao の: For example, searching for user=nao keeps logs containing that text. A shorter query such as nao also works if it keeps all target lines and removes unrelated lines.
検索で行を絞り込み、nao のログをすべて選択してください。検索語の例は「use: Narrow the logs with a search and select every log for nao. One example query is user=nao. Keep both successes and failures visible and hide at least one line.
